messages:
ajay: Heads-up — noticed weird quota/billing attribution when proxying requests from SA-bound keys. Console shows charges landing on the org default instead of the project we expect. Seen on ~3 customers after the auth-proxy rollout.
sofia: yep, saw a spike in `auth.mismatch` traces this morning. telemetry sampling shows the `x-origin-project` header is missing ~30% of the time once requests pass through the new gateway path.
maria: do we have a quick repro? curl/headers or logs would help. Also, is the exchange step dropping the header or is the proxy not setting it?
ajay: attaching a short log snippet from customer A — they hit fallback path because token exchange returned no project claim and we fall back to org-level billing. Log:
```
[auth] token-exchange: claims={} for sub=svc-123
[routing] effective_project=null fallback=org-42
```
sofia: looks like the token-introspector library returns empty when the SA has projectless scope. The proxy used to synthesize `x-origin-project` from the exchange result; new path assumes exchange always sets `project` claim.
kai: caution — synthesizing project from headers can leak membership info for cross-tenant keys. Need to make sure this only affects telemetry and billing, not perms. Also consider PII rules.
maria: agreed on privacy. Proposal: add an `effective_project` tag in the auth pipeline that is only used for billing/telemetry (no surface in audit logs), and increment a counter when we fall back to org billing. Minimal change: set tag at auth-service after exchange, keep it out of trace annotations.
sofia: cardinality concern — storing `effective_project` as high-card metric will blow out ingest. Suggest sampling + canonicalization: keep full project for storage in low-volume event stream, expose aggregated `most_likely_project` in metrics.
ajay: concrete: metric `auth.fallback.count` with `reason=fallback_no_project` and `project_hint` for sampled events. And a separate aggregated metric `auth.fallback.by_project` computed from sampled events (5% sample). Query suggestion:
```
sum by (most_likely_project) (rate(auth_fallback_sampled[5m]))
```
maria: console UX: add a small flag on the project billing page that indicates "probable attribution" with provenance (sampled from telemetry). Also add a one-click action for solutions engineers: `reassign-billing-to-project(analysis_id)` that triggers a dry-run reconciliation job.
kai: we should gate the telemetry change behind a canary and a privacy review. 5% sample -> roll to 25% -> 100% only after privacy sign-off.
ajay: Ops plan: create canary (5%) for telemetry tag, add metric + sampled event stream to prod ingest, then ship console widget in the next deploy behind a feature flag. Timeline: canary this week, flag UI next sprint.
sofia: +1. I'll sketch the code change in auth-service: add `effective_project = claim.get('project') or compute_from_headers()` and `if not claim: sampler.emit('auth.fallback', tags={'project_hint': effective_project})`.
maria: I'll pick up the console side: wire the widget to the sampled event index and show confidence %. Also add a notice if canonicalization changed after manual reassign.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable (will route 5% of traffic through auth-service canary). CI: green.
ajay: thanks all. follow-up: create GH issue and add privacy reviewers (kai + legal). I'll tag infra-oncall if we see billing drift. :thumbsup:
sofia: leaving a quick note — add a debug flag so support can toggle full attribution for a customer during triage (must be audited).
kai: noted. will handle privacy checklist.
maria: ack. creating the console PR now.
ajay: great. moving to action items.
